retrievalProfile.description: A dark, nocturnal forest scene featuring a prominent macro wood-grain texture as a canvas for psychedelic, liquid-style typography and a bright red ladybug accent.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast nocturnal composition centered on a horizontal section of rough, weathered tree bark. The bark serves as a physical substrate for warped, organic lettering that appears carved or inlaid with a darker wood texture. A single, vibrant red ladybug provides a focal point of color against the desaturated, dark blue forest background.
coreVisualRelationships: Texture-on-texture layering between the background bark and the letterforms
High color contrast between the red ladybug and the dark blue/brown environment
Organic curvature of the typography mimicking the natural flow of wood grain
Depth created by the sharp macro focus on the bark against the soft-focus forest background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large horizontal bark slab occupies the middle and lower thirds of the frame; a small ladybug sits on the upper edge of this slab.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red ladybug acts as the primary visual anchor against the dark, textured background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the ladybug, move downward through the large central typography, and then upward to the secondary header text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows in the upper forest area and lower corners provide high-contrast negative space.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and blacks of the wood grain and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Midnight blue in the background forest and sky.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant scarlet red on the ladybug and circular emblem.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high-value highlights on the wood ridges and extreme saturation on the red focal point.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earthy tones and deep blues

letterConstructionRules: Soft, rounded terminals with no sharp angles
Inner fill uses a dark, vertical wood grain texture distinct from the background
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'n' and 'm' feature exaggerated, drooping arches
Uppercase 'A' has a wide, melting base
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing between a heavy, textured organic display face and a clean, geometric outline sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Bevel and emboss on central text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the rounded, bottom-heavy organic structure

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A macro photograph of a horizontal, weathered tree log with deep ridges. In the background, a dark, out-of-focus forest at night with deep blue and black tones. A single, highly detailed red ladybug with black spots is perched on the top edge of the log.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, liquid-style psychedelic lettering centered on the log. Fill the letters with a dark vertical wood texture and add a thin tan outline. Add a secondary all-caps outline sans-serif title at the very top with a faint blue outer glow.

verificationChecks: Is the ladybug the only high-saturation red element?
Does the main text appear to be part of the wood surface?
Is the background forest sufficiently dark and blue-toned?
Are the letterforms flowing and organic?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the wood grain texture
Degree of liquid distortion in the typography
Brightness of the blue background glow
mustRedesign: Exact character shapes of the circular emblem

mustAchieve: Legible but highly stylized psychedelic forms

postGenerationChecks: Check that the wood grain in the letters is distinct from the background grain.
Ensure the ladybug has realistic highlights and shadows.
Verify the top text outline is crisp and readable against the dark trees.
Confirm the composition feels heavy and grounded.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Macro Nature Texture] + [Liquid Psychedelic Typography] + [Single Saturated Color Accent] + [Nocturnal Color Palette].
